title: When the Undertow Burns
author: Ines Whitlock
blurb: Kestrel Hartwell, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
